narrative: Inventory optimization analysis for PL3__MED63B6C reveals significant opportunities for cost reduction. The material exhibits variable demand with a coefficient of variation of 0.62 and skewed distribution characteristics. Lead time is volatile with CV of 0.79. The optimized policy increases safety stock from 127 to 844 units to achieve 95% service level, while dramatically increasing order quantity from 127 to 2692 units. This reduces ordering frequency from 915 to 43 orders per year. The dominant source of variability is lead time variability (64%), suggesting focus on supplier lead time reduction. Total annual costs decrease from $68939.32 to $6701.08, achieving $62238.25 in savings (90.3% reduction).
warnings: Lead time is volatile (CV=0.79), consider supplier improvement

research_insights.selection_rationale: Variable demand requires integrated safety stock approach
